notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-04: Title, description, and tags are editable; URL and note are not.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are shown as picker options and case-insensitively reused, but no autocomplete is provided during entry.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-20: Bulk add-tag, mark-unread, and delete exist; remove-tag, mark-read, and archive do not.
REF-BM-21: Bulk actions require explicit selected IDs and cannot target the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: The list has a fixed creation-date ordering with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Personal display settings are absent.
